chunks.text:
[Intro]
{back on the road: the rolling wave bass and a soft shaker start walking on beat one, the wind pad breathes in, then the lead calls one long reaching note that leans into the theme}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
yearning pulse-wave lead with long held notes reaching over the water
rolling plucked sampled bass rising and falling like waves
sparse harp arpeggios like distant buoys
soft brushed snare and a gentle shaker like sea foam washing in
long lonely coastal road at dusk, wistful, windswept, quietly brave
walking pulse from the first beat
